notes.title: Patch Note
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Here is a complete list of everything that has been added and corrected despite waiting for this patch because we were aware of certain bugs present on the game

if you find any other bug that we do not know how to monitor, either join the Discord to inform us or write in the community section. we will make sure to analyze the situation and understand the bug.
[b]
Update

[/b]Adding Langue Italien

We have added the Italian language to the game, the steam page will be added soon in the week to follow up with having this language added 

PATCH

°Fix Bug 00157
°Fix Bug 00158

Bug 00157 was a card loading problem that if you call on the pause button, it resets the save we fixed the problem and normally no problems with this side should be found

Bug 00158 was a collision problem between the storm and the player who was causing the sand storm to disorient it from its path. We saw the problem and corrected it.[/h3]
